data.description:
ADD O(1) NODE REMOVAL TO ThoughtGraph

FILE: cortical/reasoning/thought_graph.py
PROBLEM: Current remove_node() iterates all edges O(E) to find incident edges
SOLUTION: Add edge index mapping node_id -> set of edge_ids

IMPLEMENTATION:
1. Add _incoming_edges: Dict[str, Set[str]] and _outgoing_edges: Dict[str, Set[str]]
2. Update add_edge() to populate indices
3. Update remove_edge() to clean indices
4. Update remove_node() to use indices for O(1) edge lookup

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- All tests pass: pytest tests/unit/test_thought_graph.py -v
- remove_node() uses edge index, not iteration
- Benchmark: 1000-node graph removal in <0.01s

GUARDRAILS - DO NOT:
- Change public API signatures
- Break serialization (to_dict/from_dict)
- Modify unrelated methods

VERIFY: pytest tests/unit/test_thought_graph.py -v
data.title: Add O(1) node removal to ThoughtGraph
